definitions.explanation: A formal letter written to introduce or refer someone, most commonly used in the medical system for specialist referrals and in business for introductions.

examples.japanese: {紹介状|しょうかいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had a referral letter written for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紹介状|しょうかいじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: You need a referral letter for large hospitals.

examples.japanese: かかりつけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{紹介状|しょうかいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦もらい→もらう：00520_morau⟧、{専門医|せんもんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had my regular doctor write a referral letter and visited a specialist.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧ (introduction, referral) and ⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧ (document, letter). Most commonly encountered in the Japanese medical system.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紹介状|しょうかいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a referral letter
- {紹介状|しょうかいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧: to bring a referral letter
- {紹介状|しょうかいじょう}なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to see a doctor without a referral letter
- {紹介状|しょうかいじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧: a referral letter is needed

USAGE:
In Japan, large hospitals and university hospitals typically require a {紹介状|しょうかいじょう} from a smaller clinic or family doctor. Visiting without one results in an additional fee ({選定療養費|せんていりょうようひ}), which can be several thousand yen. This system encourages patients to see their local doctor first and keeps large hospitals focused on serious cases.
